safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting safety-net advice to seek earlier review if feeling worse can delay escalation for complications of gastroenteritis (e.g., dehydration, worsening abdominal pain, persistent fever, inability to keep fluids down), potentially leading to deterioration before reassessment. While many cases are self-limiting, the absence of clear “return sooner if worse” guidance increases risk of clinically significant delay in care.
